text: Right. so can you make either a script or interface in the hmsc-int app to import from obj or glb and add to props
resolution: Added an hmsc-int OBJ/GLB prop import path that bakes external meshes into the imported prop registry, includes Desk.glb as imported.desk, exposes imported props in the editor palette, and ships them through a new compiled map mesh-props lump so the native loader can render static imported prop meshes.
